This week, in addition to unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also introduced a brand-new iPhone wrist strap accessory. Here are the details.

Apple's new wrist strap accessory can be used together with an iPhone case and AirPods Pro.

Apple continues to expand its iPhone accessories lineup with a new addition.

In addition to the regular new cases launched alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple has also simultaneously launched a brand-new wrist strap accessory.

This wrist strap is designed to clip onto designated Apple iPhone cases and AirPods Pro, offering a more convenient, hands-free carrying solution. The strap is meticulously woven from 100% recycled PET yarn, feeling comfortable on the wrist all day long. Built-in flexible magnets help keep the strap snug and tidy.

The strap is 15.4 inches long and is compatible with most official cases for the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone 17 series.

Available colors include wine red, light blue, olive green, taupe, magenta, and black.

It can be said to be a straightforward new addition to Apple's accessories lineup. Once you attach this new strap, your iPhone and/or AirPods Pro can be securely and comfortably fastened to your wrist, providing better protection.

You can order Apple's wrist strap on Amazon for $29.

Third-party accessory manufacturers have offered similar products for years, but it is indeed gratifying to see Apple finally release an official version.

Are you planning to order a wrist strap for your iPhone or AirPods? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
